subject: English
question_text: Complete the passage using suitable connectors. 1  5 =
stimulus: Globalization is a term (a) ⎯⎯ is popularly used now. (b) ⎯⎯, it is a process of expanding trade and commerce all over the world creating a bordorless market, (c) ⎯⎯ technological development, we have conquered the time (d) ⎯⎯ distance. (e) ⎯⎯, we can learn what is happening in the farthest corner of the world.
guide_solution: Use of sentence connectors (a) which (b) Actually (c) Because of (d) and (e) As a result
